title: OrbitPremium esp aimbot
features:
++OrbitPremium.++

Visuals

Master ESP Switch
Enables or disables all ESP features at once.

Draw Box
Draws a box around each player.

Draw Name
Displays the player's name above their character.

Draw Health
Shows the player's current health.

Draw Distance
Displays the distance between you and the player.

Draw Weapon
Shows the weapon or item the player is holding.

Draw Skeleton
Draws the player's skeleton using bone lines.

Draw Snaplines
Draws lines from the screen to each player to make them easier to locate.

ESP Filters

Team Check
Ignores players who are on the same team.

Visible Check (Wall)
Limits ESP to players that are currently visible.

Aimbot

Enable Aimbot
Turns the aimbot feature on or off.

Aim Keybind
Sets the key or mouse button used to activate the aimbot.
(Shown as MouseButton2 in the image.)

Draw FOV Circle
Displays the aiming radius as a circle on the screen.

FOV Radius
Adjusts the size of the aimbot's field of view.
(Shown as 150 in the image.)

Aim Filters & Tuning

Target Hitbox
Selects which body part the aim will prioritize.
(Shown as Head.)

Velocity Prediction
Adjusts movement prediction for moving targets.
(Shown as 0.045.)

Team Check
Prevents targeting teammates.

Visible Check
Only targets players that are visible.

+Misc

Menu Toggle Key
Sets the key used to open or close the menu.
(Shown as Insert.)

Fullbright (Night Vision)
Brightens dark areas to improve visibility.

Center Crosshair
Displays a fixed crosshair at the center of the screen.

ESP Elements Visible In-Game

Box ESP
Draws a rectangular box around players.

Skeleton ESP
Displays the player's skeletal structure.

Name ESP
Shows the player's username.

Distance ESP
Displays the distance to the player.

Health ESP
Shows the player's health value.

Snaplines
Draws lines from the screen toward each player.

FOV Circle
Displays the active aiming area as a circle around the crosshair.
